extracted.name: Slower Cooker Pheasant in Mushroom Sauce
extracted.description: Easy to make and let the crockpot do all the work! Recipe from my friend Brian S.
instruction_lines: In a large crockpot place you fillet pheasant breast, onion and mushrooms.
In a large bowl pour in chicken broth and mix in flour. Then add Worcestershire, garlic, soup and seasonings.
Cover and cook 5 hours on high in crockpot. Enjoy!
